dialogues.speaker: Elzer
dialogues.text: Hmm? Oh, it's you, Traveler. Master Diluc mentioned you. Said you were an experienced and skilled adventurer...

dialogues.speaker: Elzer
dialogues.text: Ahem... I'm going off topic. So, did you come to the Dawn Winery to pick some wine?

dialogues.speaker: Elzer
dialogues.text: Sorry, but this is a bad time. Due to the storms, the three roads leading out of the winery have all been rendered impassable.

dialogues.speaker: Elzer
dialogues.text: The Knights of Favonius were able to clear the obstacles blown in by the wind quickly, but the nearby monsters have all gathered on the road for some reason.

dialogues.speaker: Elzer
dialogues.text: People can go around the area, but it is impassable to cargo-carrying carts. We can't move any of our wine out, and the ingredients we ordered can't come in. It is most frustrating...

dialogues.speaker: Elzer
dialogues.text: But I've heard of your exploits, and I know of your skills, so perhaps...

dialogues.speaker: Elzer
dialogues.text: If you would, could you get those three roads reopened?
